data.description: A hangman tree's vines are primary attacks that deal bludgeoning damage.  When a hangman tree grapples a foe with its vines, the tree does not gain the grappled condition.  A hangman tree that uses swallow whole transfers a pinned creature from a vine to inside its trunk.
data.name: Vines
